# #530 — Server-side call tracing to Langfuse: every MCP tool call as a content-ful span (supersedes #372's content-free scope)

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy

## Operator direction (Rico, 2026-08-03, verbatim intent)

"If we have Langfuse in there, all of the calls back and forth to Open Brain will be in there, and we can actually see what agents are literally trying to do, what the calls are, what they're getting back, what exists, what fails — we can full-on trace any issues. We don't have that currently in what Open Brain is storing locally by default."

## What

Instrument the rewrite server's tool dispatch (`server/main.ts`, 65 tools) so every MCP tool call emits one Langfuse span: tool name, caller identity (namespace/clientId, role), arguments, result summary or full result, error class+message on failure, duration. Session-grouped (scope/session_key as Langfuse session) so an agent's whole conversation with the brain reads as one timeline next to the client-side session traces the #523 sink already ships.

## Scope decisions already made

- CONTENT-FUL, not content-free. This explicitly supersedes #372's content-free spec for the local/dogfood deployment — operator has overridden content-free twice (2026-08-03, #523 and this). LAN-local pre-prod posture applies; no rotation ceremony for local keys. #417 (PROV-8) remains the reference for what the TS monolith's ~18 never-ported Langfuse functions covered.
- Server keys: the Vaultwarden item `Langfuse - Open Brain Local Dogfood` already exists (public_key/secret_key/hmac_secret/project_id/url fields) — use it; do not mint.
- Best-effort contract, same as the #523 sink: a Langfuse failure never fails, slows meaningfully, or alters a tool call. Async/batched export; flush on shutdown.
- Env-flag gated (OBSERVATION-family vars in the server env), off by default, on for the dogfood clone.

## Verification bar

One live session's worth of tool calls visible in Langfuse with a failing call clearly showing its error, plus a regression test that a sink failure leaves tool responses byte-identical.

## Related

#372 (content-free spec, superseded locally), #417 (PROV-8 port inventory), #523/#524 (client-side session sink, live), #529 (a failing call this would have made visible immediately).

## Discussion (2)

### rodaddy — 2026-08-04T01:31:31Z

Two operator decisions recorded 2026-08-03 (Rico, during the button-up review):

1. **SDK: Langfuse JS v4 (OTel-based), not v3.** PR #534 shipped v3; the fix round was stopped and the branch will be rebuilt on v4. The Python capture sink already lives on SDK v4, so this also converges the two lanes on one API family.
2. **Outage behavior, in the operator's words:** Langfuse is 'an extremely super important, nice to have. It shouldn't stop things from running, but it should continue loudly.' Losing an outage window's traces is acceptable ('not being able to go back and trace something doesn't really hurt us') — Postgres audit log + capture remain the system of record. The outage must be visible, 'but that should be done within reason': the alert fires on STATE CHANGE only — one content-free notice when the sink becomes unreachable ('tracing suspended'), one on recovery carrying the dropped-trace count for the window. Not per call ('if you do that every time, you're going to spend most of your time saying hey hey this isn't working'). No disk spool, no replay lane; a Postgres-backed backfill tool remains a possible future issue if a lost window ever actually hurts.

### rodaddy — 2026-08-04T03:27:35Z

## Live tracing receipt — RUNNING

The last gap is closed. PR #543 (merged, deployed b8c6214) added the `OPENBRAIN_TRACING_*` pass-through to the launcher's child-env allowlist; the deploy's revision proof passed (pid 72601 → 77523) and the running server child now carries the four tracing variables (verified `ps -p 77523 -wwE`).

**Traces observed in Langfuse** (`GET /api/public/traces?tags=open-brain-server`):

- **Success lane:** `agent_context_pack` trace `56a62cbea1e7e3b1ac250632d9c6d540` — full input arguments and full tool output in the trace body.
- **Failure lane:** `get_entity` trace `b9224aaf852c99ab609fd8b7420bebec` — input `{"id":"00000000-…"}`, output `{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Entity not found"}],"isError":true}`.
- **Real traffic, unprompted:** live capture-hook calls from other sessions are flowing — `session_start`, `get_contract`, `ingest_raw_turn`, `append_session_event` traces appeared within seconds of the deploy, with content.

One behavior to know, by design of the wrapper seam: a call the MCP SDK rejects at schema validation (wrong/missing argument shape) never reaches the wrapped handler, so it produces **no trace** — the trace lane covers every call that executes, including ones that return `isError:true`. Schema rejections surface only in the client's own error response.

This is the "fully logging everything and we're tracing stuff" finish line for the server side: every executed tool call, success or failure, is now a content-ful Langfuse trace tagged `open-brain-server`.
